assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer with a precise local face repair. The provided image is the EDIT TARGET. Modify this exact accepted classroom picture; keep its composition, camera, character count, positions, identities, poses, desks, chairs, windows, books and caption layout. Produce a restrained, carefully designed classic handheld RPG pixel-art version.

TOP PRIORITY LOCAL REPAIR: the FIRST occupied paired desk in the lower-left foreground, LEFTMOST student, brown-haired boy resting his cheek on one hand and looking at his navy-haired deskmate to the right. This is NOT the protagonist sitting far back at the right window, and NOT any student with glasses. At the target image's 1672x941 scale the face is around x=130..210, y=432..490, both eye centers around x=161 and 190, y=455. His eyes currently look inconsistent. Repair ONLY his eyes and immediately adjoining eyelid pixels: two natural coherent eyes at the correct level for his gently turned face, properly separated, matching simple pupil shapes, both pupils looking toward the same deskmate on SCREEN RIGHT, no crossed or divergent pupils, no missing pupil, no duplicate eye or eye on the cheek. Respect slight perspective foreshortening. Keep his head orientation, hair, mouth, chin-on-hand pose and expression. Make the repair clear at ordinary image size.

STYLE CHANGE THROUGHOUT SCENE: keep visible uniform square pixel clusters and intentional staircase contours. Shift to classic GBA-like native pixel artwork with restrained shared colors, broad flat forms, three simple tones per material and clean dark navy pixel outlines. Reduce high-frequency scattered texture, glossy orange highlights and tiny noisy details. Hair uses a few coherent clumps, skin one base and one soft colored shadow, school vests simple teal planes. Wood remains warm amber/tan but becomes matte. FLOOR tiles become matte tan with thin deliberate pixel seams, one quiet window-light shape and solid restrained cool shadows; remove bright mirror reflections, gold glow, glossy streaks, dramatic golden rim lighting. Light source remains the original right windows. Keep warm classroom versus cool rainy outside, clear depth and cute refined figures without a cinematic painted finish. Trees and rain through windows simplified into arranged green/blue clusters and sparse crisp rain dashes. Caption remains high-resolution crisp for reading; no blur, smooth gradients, bloom, paint texture or posterized photographic look.

STRUCTURAL INVARIANTS: camera from FRONT looking to REAR cabinets, window wall remains SCREEN RIGHT. Three lanes of paired wooden desks: two desks joined side-by-side per pair, two chairs behind, no new chairs, no moved desks. Quiet original brown-haired protagonist stays at far-back right window seat, navy-haired deskmate immediately to his left. Seated hips supported by seats, thighs under tables, two feet per person, standing students' feet grounded. Preserve all original classroom objects and spacing, no added wear marks, props, labels or new students. Horizontal sliding window frames and glass remain straight with same perspective and dimensions, no hinged windows. Original still scene, full 16:9, no crop, no camera change.

Exact existing bottom caption, two lines, large white type on dark navy RPG panel, keep every character and punctuation:
不知道大家的中学生活是怎么样的？
主播高中的教室是狭窄逼仄的。
Keep the decorative panel corners and full frame. This is ONE edited static image.

assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. The provided river scene is the EDIT TARGET. Restyle THIS SAME accepted image into restrained classic handheld RPG pixel artwork. Preserve the camera, composition and every character's identity, position, scale, body posture and expression, the brown-haired schoolboy on the central stepping stone, all friend groups on both banks, the bridge and school buildings, trees, grass, rocks, floating paper sheets and bottom caption.

Main style direction: visibly deliberate low-resolution square pixel clusters, coherent staircase contours, simple flat color regions, dark navy/blue-green outlines where needed, restrained approximately 32-color art-direction palette rather than glittery high-detail digital painting. Each material uses roughly three clear tones. Maintain cheerful but quieter green, cyan/blue, warm sand/tan and teal-uniform colors. Simplify high-frequency sparkle and noisy texture, while keeping lovely composition and recognizable characters.

WATER: redesign its rendering as broad connected blue regions with a few long clean light-cyan pixel ripple strokes following the current and a simple bright outline around stones. Reduce the dense hundreds of white sparkle fragments and photoreal reflective microtexture. Show a calm readable current, not a solid featureless blue shape. No glowing streaks, bloom or smooth gradient.
TREES AND GRASS: large arranged leaf clumps with base/light/shadow greens, clear silhouette, fewer scattered single-pixel yellow highlights. Grass banks use tidy repeated grouped pixel tufts and limited small flowers ALREADY present in target, no added flora or new props.
ROCKS AND BUILDINGS: matte three-tone planes, restrained shadows, fewer glossy edges and over-detailed facade textures. Preserve shapes, location and perspective.
CHARACTERS: keep current brown hair, teal school vests, white shirts, red ties and navy clothing, original proportions and faces, two coherent limbs per person, central boy's two shoes remain grounded on the SAME exposed stone. Keep groups on the same banks, no new people, no removed figures, no movement or newly invented gestures. Do not turn classroom imagery into this scene; it is already a standalone metaphor.

Keep the exact existing dark navy RPG caption panel, decorative pixel corners and large clean white Chinese typography, full original text in two legible lines:
我其实一直不懂，同学们分明与我在同一条河流里面
翻来覆去，却轻而易举地找到了水的边界。
No rewriting, omitted punctuation, new words, logos or labels. Typography can remain high-resolution. Full 16:9, no cropping, no camera movement. Make pixels feel designed through clean clustered shapes and restrained light/color, not just coarse pixelation of unchanged shiny artwork.
